title: The ferry at Dunmere
lines: dm
The ferry at Dunmere is tied up and Old Pell is asleep on the dock.
a
Tamsin shakes Old Pell awake and asks for a crossing.
dm
Old Pell grumbles that the river is too high tonight, but he names a price of ten silver.
b
Brogan pays the ten silver and climbs aboard.
dm
Halfway across, the ferry rope snaps with a crack.
a
Tamsin grabs the broken rope and ties it around the mast.
b
Brogan throws his weight on the pole and steers for the far bank.
dm
The ferry grinds onto the gravel and Old Pell sits down, shaking.
dm
On the far bank a hooded figure waits with a lantern and watches them land.
a
Tamsin asks the figure who they are.
dm
The figure says only that the party is late, and walks into the trees.
b
Brogan wants to follow, but Tamsin holds him back until morning.
